entities.summary: Karol Kulczycki, SDS is a Polish-born Australian bishop of the Catholic Church and a member of the Society of the Divine Savior. He is the bishop of the Diocese of Port Pirie, appointed to the position in 2020. He was first transferred to Australia in 1997, before returning to his home country in 2018. He has since been back to Australia numerous times as of 2026.
